newsitem.title: JAPAN: Teijin to start LCD parts production - paper.
newsitem.headline: Teijin to start LCD parts production - paper.

text.p: Teijin Ltd will begin producing parts for liquid crystal displays (LCDs) and expects annual sales from the new business to hit 15 billion yen in 2005, the business daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said on Wednesday.
A spokesman for Teijin was not immediately available for comment.
The paper said Teijin's plan includes investment of five to six billion yen for the production of film used in LCDs by 2000.
The paper said Japanese synthetic fibre makers, suffering from sluggish business, are accelerating expansion into new business fields.
Major LCD maker Sharp Corp said on Tuesday that the size of the world LCD market is expected to reach 1.5 trillion yen in the fiscal year from April 1, 1999, about 2.2 times larger than in 1996/97.
